advisories.quote: this version replaces the one first published under this title
advisories.assessment: Inherited verbatim in substance from the supplied internal_article line 17. It is not a new invention unique to A. This reviewer has no independent publication record, so publication history remains unverified beyond that supplied assertion. Do not classify it as fabricated without further evidence.

The no-behavioral-validation boundary is supported. House_style line 98 explicitly refers to compile checks and disallows promotion to behavioral validation. No detailed implementation-level judge definition was established in this review; the statement should remain bounded to the recorded guarantee and checks. This is not raised as a proven factual defect.

The proposals are reasonable, but 'would show which endpoints are stable' and the judges-versus-environments dichotomy are stronger than an unspecified design guarantees. Prefer language about testing stability and helping separate effects, with matched outputs or cases and other conditions held fixed. This is an inferential wording refinement rather than a numerical mismatch.
advisories.suggested_public_wording: Repeated seeds would test how stable the endpoints are. Judging matched cases under both guarantees would help separate guarantee effects from environment differences.

advisories.assessment: The 98 count correctly denotes scored zero-pass tuples. Adding 'scored' directly to the claim would make explicit why11 entirely unscored rows with no PASS are excluded. Earlier context distinguishes absence from zero outcomes.
The caption's broad 'in grey' description is supported by the packet and pale grey/blue-grey omission fills. 'Light grey' is optional precision, not a material caption error.
